name: Andaz Prague
insider_take: Where contemporary luxury meets Prague's baroque grandeur in the heart of the Golden City.
whats_special: Andaz Prague occupies a stunning location on Wenceslas Square, Prague's most famous boulevard, where the Velvet Revolution unfolded in 1989. The hotel seamlessly blends modern design with the city's rich history, featuring locally-inspired artwork and offering breathtaking views of the historic square where Czech independence was declared.
pro_tip: Book a room on the upper floors facing Wenceslas Square for spectacular views of the National Museum and to witness the square's vibrant energy, especially beautiful during Prague's famous Christmas markets.
dont_miss: The hotel's rooftop terrace offers unparalleled panoramic views of Prague Castle and the city's iconic red rooftops. Take advantage of the complimentary non-alcoholic minibar and local snacks - a signature Andaz perk. The location puts you within walking distance of the Astronomical Clock, Charles Bridge, and Old Town Square.
pros: Prime location in historic Prague city center
Contemporary design blended with local Czech culture
